title: Sewer facilities.
officialText:
All new and replaced sanitary sewer facilities, private sewage treatment plants (including all pumping
stations and collector systems) and on-site waste disposal systems shall be designed in accordance with Chapter 7, ASCE 24, to
minimize or eliminate infiltration of floodwaters into the facilities and discharge from the facilities into floodwaters, or impairment
of the facilities and systems.
